statusCheck.token: font .system(size: KeyStyle.bodySize, weight: .semibold) to match the word beside it (HIG: a symbol takes the weight of adjacent text), foreground cutling.tintColor

imageStatus.token: KeyStyle.titleSize - 2, .semibold, white, shadow black 0.4 r2 y1 (same as the name it replaces)

notes.keyboardBackground: light sampled from fastlane/compose/creative/assets/screens/phone/chat.png at (660,2150); dark is a GUESS for the mock only, the real keyboard sits on the system's glass
notes.keyFill: UIColor.keyBackground: light white 1.05 alpha 0.75 (sampled #FDFDFD), dark white 145/255 alpha 0.30
notes.wash: cutling.tintColor at washOpacity, drawn above the key fill and below the content, clipped to the card. Image cards get no wash.
notes.statusColour: word in .primary so any user hex tint still reads; only the checkmark takes cutling.tintColor

copy.notes: Both words already exist in the string catalogue. The VoiceOver strings are new keys, %@ is the cutling's name, never its text (a cutling may be a password).

timeline.origin: t = 0 is the Button action (touch-up), the moment the text is inserted. The touch-down highlight and light haptic are unchanged and happen before t = 0.

elements.transition: symbolEffect(.drawOn.wholeSymbol), iOS 26+; symbolEffect(.appear) on iOS 18 to 25
elements.durationNote: system-owned; 0.40 is the mock's stand-in, measure on device

timeline.springs: every 'smooth' is Animation.smooth(duration:) = spring(duration:, bounce: 0); no element of the mark overshoots
timeline.stagger: the outgoing line leaves in 0.15 s and the incoming one starts 0.05 s after the insert (or after the hold), so a two-line preview never sits under the one-line status; drawn at t = 0.08 and 1.50 in mock.png

repeat.sameKey: serial += 1; the status line stays (no blur-out and back); checkmark and icon each play .bounce once; hold restarts so the mark leaves at lastTap + hold
repeat.otherKey: the first key's mark leaves at once with its own exit (statusOut, previewIn, washOut); the new key's mark enters at the same instant; only one key carries the mark
repeat.duringExit: a tap on the same key after the hold, while the line is leaving: a fresh status line enters with the normal entry while the old one finishes its 0.15 s exit; the wash retargets from wherever it is (opacity spring keeps its velocity, WWDC23 10158)
repeat.keyboardHidden: viewWillDisappear cancels the hold and clears the mark, so a reopened keyboard never shows a stale one

reduceMotion.checkDraw: none: the checkmark arrives with the line's opacity

voiceOver.announcement: UIAccessibility.post(notification: .announcement) with an NSAttributedString of voiceOverInserted or voiceOverCopied and .accessibilitySpeechQueueAnnouncement = true, so it queues after any echo of the typed text; posted once per insert, after insertText returns
voiceOver.keyLabel: unchanged; the key's label stays the cutling's name while the mark shows
voiceOver.statusLine: accessibilityHidden(true): the announcement carries the news; the key's label while marked is its name

mock.notes: mock-only stand-ins for system transitions (blurReplace blur and scale, draw progress, bounce peak); the builder uses the system blurReplace, drawOn and bounce and does not copy these numbers
